## Completed construction: actual paid current, conditional matching and an occupied-state boundary

**NON-CANONICAL / L1. Conditional analytical candidate-T; finite candidate-C on x86_64. Independent acceptance pending. No measured alpha, native-U or physical electromagnetic identification.**

### 1. Current comes from the actual source transition

For the admitted ordinary contact, with t=(x-y)/2 and rho=j^2,

`i=(1-rho)t, x'=x-i, y'=y+i`.

Put the two source slots at the ends of one declared D3 edge. The single-edge flux increment i has divergence (-i,+i), exactly the source charge change. There is no additional current-amplitude parameter. The additive charge reading and the current-to-field operation are explicit model premises.

The current lies in `(1-rho)O=(1-j)O`. Thus an ordinary contact does not move the unit J as a RAW charge; the cold source e=J transfers `(1-rho)J=(2,1,1,1)`. Its half-trace account is 5, and its principal Hermitian norm is `3-phi`. This last identity does not derive a fourth root or alpha.

### 2. Work and field are paid on the same transition

Retain #1924's actual source potential `V=Q(y-e)` and ready source `(e,-e,e)`. Its first contact releases exactly `W=Q(i)`. On the unchanged #1926 field, extended coefficientwise with the SAME half-trace metric, the cold injected-field energy is `z Q(i)/(2c)` on an edge of weight c. After the following free field step that energy is unchanged.

A source work bank initially zero leaves `(1-z/(2c))Q(i)`. Passivity permits `0<z<=2c`; the EXTRA condition of complete conversion with no remaining scalar work selects `z=2c`. The nearest edge `(1,1,0)` has c=1/54, giving `z=1/27`. All five shell entries instead give `1/27,1/162,5/54,1/162,1/162`, so one scalar cannot fully match identical sources on all five differently weighted shells. No target-alpha selection was used.

Before free propagation, five source contacts can store the old bank history in the actual field: `0,5,10,10,5,0` for J. Reading that field account at cuts one and two gives archives `(5,10)` and the inherited prepared pointer ends at `j^-1`. The core plus pointer is 25 and archive funding is 125, total 150. This is a STATIC five-cut comparison; it is not the same statement as inserting free wave evolution between its contacts. Reversal removes records and phase as well as restoring resources.

### 3. Reciprocal field-loaded collision

For arbitrary occupied fields define `F=E-KA/(2z)`, `a=z/(2c)` and

`d=(2y-x-e+a F_edge)/(3+a)`.

Refuse if d is not integral. Otherwise set

`i=(rho-1)d, x'=x-i, y'=y+i, E'=E+i delta_edge`, with A,e unchanged.

Completing the local quadratic square proves exact conservation of

`Q(x)+Q(y)+Q(e)+Q(y-e)+H_z(A,E)`.

The fixed quantities `S=x+y` and `b=F_edge-y` make d a displacement from a fixed center, rotated by rho. Its integrality domain is invariant, hence the full map is bijective, its inverse is its fourth power, and its fifth power is identity including refusals. Gauss is preserved by the actual current. This is a NEW field-loaded arithmetic law, not an ordinary-contact compiler or a symplecticity theorem. It agrees with the original contact on the cold nonzero family exactly when a=1.

Composing with the inherited free-field step gives a complete conserving bijection. A signed record of actual field work, with explicit price w^2 and a nonnegative funding bank, has a complete occupied-state inverse and affordability refusal. The one-record first J experiment has core account 21, archive funding 25 and total 46; it is distinct from the 150-account static source/pointer construction. No #1924 phase law is asserted for arbitrary loaded trajectories.

### 4. The repeated cold trial reaches a real arithmetic boundary

At z=1/27, the first J collision emits energy 5 and the first free field displacement is `2 i` on the source edge. The next collision displacement is

`d2=-(193rho+23)J/216=(85/108,193/216,-23/216,193/216)`.

It is nonintegral. The first three tested macrosteps have collision admission `1,0,0`. This refusal is retained, not repaired. The marked diagonal `K_edge,edge=23/1458` gives the same result analytically on the infinite local stencil.

The least positive integer source/field amplitude multiplier permitting this SECOND collision is exactly 216. A separate frozen test checked every multiplier 1..216 and the admitted scaled inverse. The first field energy then becomes `233280=5*216^2`; the quadratic energy multiplier is 46656. This does not prove further admissions or a low-cost repeated emitter.

### 5. Static work of the same charge and a normalization control

On the fixed 27-site quotient, all thirty labelled edge directions and sources e=1,J passed exact static Poisson and energy checks. For the marked edge,

`R_eff=3776/1755`,
`H_long/H_injected=1888/47385`,
`H_injected=5`, `H_long=1888/9477`, `H_trans=45497/9477`.

The weighted-orthogonal longitudinal/transverse split recombines exactly under one free field step, and the same-charge static read returns z=1/27. This is an algebraic decomposition, NOT a relaxation algorithm, charge dressing, measured radiation probability or an infinite-volume result. No component is discarded.

Normalizing the current from `(1-rho)t` to t requires transporting its metric to `Q_lambda(t)=Q((1-rho)t)`. Keeping the old Q instead gives incompatible work ratios `5/2` at t=1 and `5/3` at t=J. That attempted scalar normalization fails already on two exact sources.

### Evidence and delivery

Original source pin `16a3efdefafa351a2f33393637eb535b8eb27819` remains unchanged. First run: 28,604 exact assertions; stdout 827 bytes, SHA-256 `59c5ab14eadb2958011998f1435b812de5c5465181d10c272339e527da4d60ab`; exit 0, empty stderr.

Additive source pin `4547b4fa9193a966ea47865457ebe541c8a73629` also remains unchanged. First static run: 519 exact assertions; stdout 508 bytes, SHA-256 `e1171facd76e52c05b1cb63b3d128bb88897b2a12398d109433130b24779ba68`; exit 0, empty stderr.

Both clean source-pin replays were byte-identical. All scientific runs used Linux x86_64 / Python 3.13.5. The additive script reuses the disclosed field implementation; neither replay is independent acceptance or a two-architecture gate. No failed run or moved threshold occurred.

Final standalone Git head `a0185a22b91eacdfe91aa070be246a5e54ae2a20`. Handoff `PROMO-C-CONTACT-FIELD-CURRENT-MATCH-N.bundle`: 34,508 bytes; SHA-256 `0610ecaf9545eeecfe1e41e8685f489fc0195d318cd72cdfbb5062e6afe3ce0d`. The complete proof, additive boundary proof, frozen scripts, outputs and correctly authored Git history are delivered in the originating conversation. Public main remains `d4d363722f052141a4ce65e9da39f11a74b43b95`; no PR, Canon, registry, gate, workflow, merge or release changed.
